hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels checks available_quantity with a plain unlocked read, and createReservationItems_ then writes reserved_quantity as the stale level value plus the adjustment. Two concurrent completions of carts that each need the single SOLO unit (stock 1) on two servers may both pass the availability check and both write a reserved counter, so the counter can disagree with the live reservation rows, or two live reservations can exceed stock (no_oversell). I expect reserved_matches_reservations to fail in some runs, and possibly no_oversell.
